name: Guardian Standard of Recovery heals the amount its buff advertises, including Strength scaling (#6604)
contract: Standard of Recovery 500260 summons creature 50053, which casts 500266 on itself: an APPLY_AREA_AURA_FRIEND whose effect 0 is aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL with EffectBasePoints 79 (amount 80) and Amplitude 3000, triggering the direct heal 500248. The buff's own aura tooltip (Spell.dbc column 187) is the client-visible contract and reads 'A nearby Standard of Recovery is causing you to regenerate ${$w1+$STR*.25} health every $t1 sec', i.e. the aura's own effect amount plus 0.25 x the owner's Strength. Effect 1 is the '+$s2% healing received' half, aura 319 with BasePoints 5. The tick is script-driven: aura_ascension_guardian_recovery::Tick prevents the native trigger and re-casts 500248 with an explicit amount. The bug (#6604, level 30, core 4666cd9941c0) is that the script built that amount from the triggered spell 500248's own EffectBasePoints (79 -> base 2), not from the standard aura's effect amount (80): at the reporter's 124 Strength the buff advertised 80 + 31 = 111 health but the tick healed 2 + 31 = 33. This scenario pins the contract at level 1, where the Strength term is at most a few points, so the ratio of one tick's effective healing to the aura's own advertised amount is 1 for a correct tick and ~0.03 for the defect. The heal target's health is fixtured low with a large pool so nothing is overhealed. The three inputs of that cast text's own formula are asserted exactly here, so the published text cannot drift from the spell it describes: the aura's effect 0 amount, which is the value the client renders as $500266m1, must read 80; the owner's Strength, which is its $STR term, must read 27; and one tick must land at (80 + floor(0.25 x 27)) x the buff's own +6% healing received = 91, i.e. 1.1375 of that advertised 80.

steps.label: SETUP: the starter Hearthstone satisfies 500260's TotemCategory 5
The Standard of Recovery banner summons
The owner carries the Standard's periodic buff
CONTRACT: the buff's advertised amount $w1 is the Standard aura's own 80, which is the $500266m1 the cast tooltip now bills
SETUP: the owner's Strength is the fixed 27 the tooltip's $STR term multiplies by 0.25, so the tick's amount is determinate
Fixture a low health inside a large pool so the tick is never overhealed
One tick heals exactly (80 + floor(0.25 x 27)) x the buff's own +6% = 91, i.e. 1.1375 of the advertised 80; the band admits one tick and rejects both the pre-fix 0.2 and a second tick at 2.275
The heal lands through the native heal log
